value.answer: Sorry you're looking for one. In Toronto, ConnexOntario is free, open 24/7 at 1-866-531-2600, and can point you to the right service. If it's depression or anxiety, the Ontario Structured Psychotherapy program offers free short-term CBT for adults. Family Service Toronto charges sliding-scale fees based on income. For a private therapist, Psychotherapy Referral Service connects you with registered psychotherapists, and First Session offers free consultations. Your work's EAP may cover a few free sessions, and extended health plans often cover private therapy. If it gets urgent, Distress Centres of Greater Toronto is free and 24/7 by phone, chat or text.
